query:
SELECT
                p.policy_type,
                p.title,
                pv.version,
                pv.content,
                pv.published_at
            FROM policies p
            INNER JOIN policy_versions pv ON pv.policy_id = p.id
            WHERE p.policy_type = $1
              AND pv.status = 'published'
            ORDER BY pv.version DESC
            LIMIT 1
